arxiv-2102-01818.title: Memorization vs. Generalization: Quantifying Data Leakage in NLP Performance Evaluation
arxiv-2102-01818.creator: Aparna Elangovan, Jiayuan He, Karin Verspoor
arxiv-2102-01818.description: Abstract Public datasets are often used to evaluate the efficacy and generalizability of state-of-the-art methods for many tasks in natural language processing (NLP). However, the presence of overlap between the train and test datasets can lead to inflated results, inadvertently evaluating the model’s ability to memorize and interpreting it as the ability to generalize.

arxiv-2103-01918.title: Measurements of differential cross-sections in four-lepton events in 13 TeV proton–proton collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2103-01918.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2103-01918.description: Abstract Measurements of four-lepton differential and integrated fiducial cross-sections in events with two same-flavour, opposite-charge electron or muon pairs are presented. The data correspond to 139 fb -1 of s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV proton–proton collisions, collected by the ATLAS detector during Run 2 of the Large Hadron Collider (2015–2018).

arxiv-2402-11818.title: Where It Really Matters: Few-Shot Environmental Conservation Media Monitoring for Low-Resource Languages
arxiv-2402-11818.creator: Sameer Jain, Sedrick Scott Keh, Shova Chettri, Karun Dewan, Pablo Izquierdo, Johanna Prussman, Pooja Shreshtha, César Suárez, Zheyuan Ryan Shi, Lei Li, Fei Fang
arxiv-2402-11818.description: Abstract Environmental conservation organizations routinely monitor news content on conservation in protected areas to maintain situational awareness of developments that can have an environmental impact. Existing automated media monitoring systems require large amounts of data labeled by domain experts, which is only feasible at scale for high-resource languages like English.

arxiv-2410-00439.title: Spin-mechanical thermal machines
arxiv-2410-00439.creator: Mohamed Hatifi, Anshuman Nayak, Jason Twamley
arxiv-2410-00439.description: Abstract We introduce a method to construct a quantum battery and a quantum Otto heat engine using a Nitrogen-Vacancy (NV) center spin coupled to a mechanical oscillator in a highly detuned regime. By precisely controlling the NV spin, we enable efficient energy exchange despite significant detuning, challenging conventional assumptions.

arxiv-2411-17597.title: Belief patterns with information processing Thanks: I thank Ennio Bilancini, Santiago Oliveros, Ludovic Renou, and Katharine Rockett for helpful comments and suggestions on a much earlier draft. All errors are mine.
arxiv-2411-17597.creator: Federico Vaccari
arxiv-2411-17597.description: Abstract This paper presents a model of costly information acquisition where decision-makers can choose whether to elaborate information superficially or precisely. The former action is costless, while the latter entails a processing cost. Within this framework, decision-makers’ beliefs may polarize even after they have access to the same evidence.

arxiv-2508-01522.title: Decentralized Aerial Manipulation of a Cable-Suspended Load using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2508-01522.creator: Jack Zeng, Andreu Matoses Gimenez, Eugene Vinitsky, Javier Alonso-Mora, Sihao Sun
arxiv-2508-01522.description: Abstract This paper presents the first decentralized method to enable real-world 6-DoF manipulation of a cable-suspended load using a team of Micro-Aerial Vehicles (MAVs). Our method leverages multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train an outer-loop control policy for each MAV.

arxiv-2511-17040.title: Step-E: A Differentiable Data Cleaning Framework for Robust Learning with Noisy Labels
arxiv-2511-17040.creator: Du Wenzhang
arxiv-2511-17040.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Du Wenzhang. Training data collected in the wild often contain noisy labels and outliers that substantially degrade the performance and reliability of deep neural networks [ 18 , 3 ] . While data cleaning is commonly applied as a separate preprocessing stage [ 15 , 9 , 16 ] , such two-stage pipelines neither fully exploit feedback from the downstream model nor adapt to unknown noise patterns.

arxiv-2601-05818.title: A Phenomenological Study of the Accretion Disk in the Super-Eddington AGN I Zw 1 2026 A Phenomenological Study of the Accretion Disk in the Super-Eddington AGN I Zw 1 – 6
arxiv-2601-05818.creator: Farin Drewes, Roberta Vieliute, Juan V. Hernández Santisteban, Keith Horne, Aaron J. Barth, Edward M. Cackett, Encarni Romero Colmenero, Michael R. Goad, Shai Kaspi, Hermine Landt, Paulina Lira, Hagai Netzer, Marianne Vestergaard, Hartmut Winkler
arxiv-2601-05818.description: Abstract The structure of the accretion disk in AGN is still an unsolved question, especially how it may change with Eddington ratio. Here we examine the accretion disk in the super-Eddington AGN I Zw 1 using reverberation mapping of the optical continuum.

pmc-10650848.title: Adding Value to Liquid Biopsy for Brain Tumors: The Role of Imaging
pmc-10650848.creator: Nastaran Khalili, Hossein Shooli, Nastaran Hosseini, Anahita Fathi Kazerooni, Ariana Familiar, Sina Bagheri, Hannah Anderson, Stephen J Bagley, Ali Nabavizadeh, Enrico Franceschi
pmc-10650848.description: Simple SummaryClinical management in neuro-oncology has shifted to an integrated method that combines molecular profiles with histopathological and imaging data. Liquid biopsy is a non-invasive method that captures the molecular diversity of the whole tumor by detecting specific tumor biomarkers that circulate in body fluids like the cerebrospinal fluid.

pmc-11353308.title: AGXT2 Suppresses the Proliferation and Dissemination of Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells by Modulating Intracellular Lipid Metabolism
pmc-11353308.creator: Tian Chen, Lunjian Xiang, Wenjin Zhang, Zhenyi Xia, Weixian Chen
pmc-11353308.description: PurposeAlanine glyoxylate aminotransferase (AGXT) family members are crucial in cancer processes, but their role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) metabolism is unclear. This study investigates AGXT2’s function in HCC.Patients and MethodsAGTX2 expression was studied using bioinformatics, real-time reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), Western blot, and Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).

pmc-11630843.title: Efficient genome monomer higher-order structure annotation and identification using the GRMhor algorithm
pmc-11630843.creator: Matko Glunčić, Domjan Barić, Vladimir Paar, Lina Ma
pmc-11630843.description: MotivationTandem monomeric units, integral components of eukaryotic genomes, form higher-order repeat (HOR) structures that play crucial roles in maintaining chromosome integrity and regulating gene expression and protein abundance. Given their significant influence on processes such as evolution, chromosome segregation, and disease, developing a sensitive and automated tool for identifying HORs across diverse genomic sequences is essential.

pmc-11655820.title: The roles of LncRNA CARMN in cancers: biomarker potential, therapeutic targeting, and immune response
pmc-11655820.creator: Huafeng Liu, Xuewen Liu, Yanjun Lu
pmc-11655820.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Long non-coding RNAs (LncRNAs) are crucial regulators of gene expression and cellular processes, with significant implications for cancer research. This review focuses on the role of LncRNA CARMN (Cardiac Arrest and Regulated Myocyte Nuclear Protein) in various cancers. CARMN, originally identified for its function in cardiac tissues, has shown dysregulated expression in several tumor types, including cervical, breast, colorectal, and esophageal cancers.

pmc-12466889.title: In Vitro and In Silico Analysis of Differential Antibacterial Activity of Pomegranate Polyphenols Against Gram-Positive and Gram-Negative Bacteria
pmc-12466889.creator: Relja Suručić, Maja Travar, Tatjana Kundaković Vasović, Jelena Radović Selgrad, Ljiljana Suručić, Milan Momčilović, Miloš P. Stojiljković, Ranko Škrbić
pmc-12466889.description: Background/Objectives: This study investigates the antimicrobial properties of pomegranate peel extract (PoPEx) and its major polyphenolic constituents against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, employing six clinical isolates of Staphylococcus aureus and five isolates of Escherichia coli. The study further aims to elucidate mechanisms of action through molecular docking and transport studies. Methods: Chemical composition was analyzed using liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC–MS).

pmc-12482281.title: Circulating-free DNA and myocardial infarction: From diagnostic promise to clinical translation
pmc-12482281.creator: Jeff Clyde G Corpuz
pmc-12482281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This correspondence responds to the review by Rafiei et al. on circulating-free DNA (cfDNA) as a biomarker for early detection of myocardial infarction (MI). CfDNA shows potential for rapid diagnosis and real-time monitoring, but major barriers remain. Lack of standardized testing methods, uncertain utility in emergency care, and high costs risk delaying adoption and widening health inequities, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs).

pmc-12629132.title: Central Corneal Epithelial Wounding Accelerates Aniridia-Associated Keratopathy in PAX6-Deficient Mice
pmc-12629132.creator: Yedizza Rautavaara, Israa Sefawi, Meri Vattulainen, Petros Moustardas, Dina Javidjam, Ava Dashti, Neil Lagali
pmc-12629132.description: PurposeTo investigate corneal healing in a Pax6+/− mouse model of aniridia-associated keratopathy (AAK) when challenged with a mild epithelial wound.Methods Pax6+/− small-eye (Sey) mice (n = 15) and Pax6+/+ wild-type mice (n = 4) on the 129S1/SvImJ background underwent 1 mm central corneal mechanical epithelial debridement. Corneal status before and four weeks after wounding was evaluated by slit-lamp imaging.

pmc-13120012.title: Polarization-Independent Metasurface Color Filter with Side-Peak Suppression in Metallic Nanohole Array
pmc-13120012.creator: Hui-Jin Yun, Seung-Yeol Lee
pmc-13120012.description: Recent advances in metasurface-based research have enabled significant reductions in the size and weight of optical devices. By employing metallic nanostructures with subwavelength dimensions, color filtering can be achieved through phenomena such as extraordinary optical transmission (EOT), which allows specific bands of visible light to pass through.

pmc-13405256.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used in educational decision-making. This raises important questions about how students perceive and accept outcomes from non-human agents. Based on authority acceptance theory and organizational justice theory, this study explored three research questions: how decision-making agents (teachers vs.

pmc-13427780.creator: Hasim Bakbak, Gurpremjit Singh, Theodora Maria Zavos, Aravindh Rathinam, Tomas Panqueva Baena, Ahmad Abdelaziz, Jonathan Elliot Katz, Robert Marcovich, Alan J Wein, Hemendra Navinchandra Shah

pmc-13517924.title: The Combination of Chinese Medicine Monomers Reduces 7S Globulin-Induced Damage to IPEC-J2 Cells In Vitro by Modulating NF-κB/MAPK Pathway-Related Markers
pmc-13517924.creator: Ya Wang, Zhengyi Shen, Ling Lv, Zhiguo Li, Chen Yu, Renwu Zhou, Yunhao Su, Youtian Deng, Junliang Deng, Huidan Deng
pmc-13517924.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummarySoybean 7S globulin, also known as β-conglycinin, is a major dietary storage protein that frequently causes severe diarrhea in weaned piglets, leading to compromised intestinal epithelial damage, acute inflammatory responses, and impaired nutrient absorption. To identify a safe, highly effective, and antibiotic-free intervention, this study systematically evaluated various optimized combinations of four bioactive phytochemicals derived from traditional Chinese medicine—Eleutheroside E, Anemoside B4, Forsythoside A, and Esculin.

pmc-13678618.title: Comparative study of the direct and photocatalytic light activation of platinum(iv) prodrugs†
pmc-13678618.creator: Kinjal Mileche, Susana M. Meza Huaman, Ke Wu, Jake A. Vickery, Hannah Coxhead, Alexander N. Smith-Xu, Patricia Juhl Allworthy, Jovana Katrinka-Mavrak, Aminesena Baser, Safacan Kolemen, Manuel M. Müller, Mahvash Tavassoli, Ismael Diez-Perez, Eleanor Stride, John F. Callan, Adam C. Sedgwick
pmc-13678618.description: Here, we present a comparative study of direct and photocatalyst-mediated photoactivation of reporter-functionalised Pt(iv) prodrugs, Carbo-4NP and CarboNap. Direct blue-light irradiation and green-light activation using the photocatalyst Rose Bengal both achieved rapid and complete Pt(iv) reduction in solution, monitored by UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopy. Translation to live cells revealed a marked divergence between the two approaches.
